attempts_and_limits.detail: Initial temporary native test reached a source/Cemetery native-tool pin mismatch (reconcile-deaths.py); corrected checkout to source pin 09225018 and reran successfully. Original temporary game files were removed by unittest cleanup; no endpoint or raw-stream claim is made for that setup attempt.

First compressor encountered the suite atomic partial-directory rename; originals were preserved and compression retried. All final complete decision traces are retained losslessly in stream payloads.

An initial unpublished canonical export lacked compressed trace tails. Re-exported to a fresh working registry with exact decompressed trace bytes; retained dossiers all include the real trace tail and original line count.
No GUI interaction, population tuning, default changes or effectiveness claim. Native override demonstrates one real configured policy change only.
